product_metadata.title: Fox Run Heart Tea Infuser, 0.25 x 1.75 x 6.25 inches, Metallic
features: Set of 2 infusers, feature a cute heart shape
Allows you to easily brew your favorite loose leaf tea, perfect for a single cup of tea
Equipped with hook attached on end of chain to hang on mug for hassle-free removal
description: You don't need to compromise quality for convenience! Replace your old tea bags and ensure the greatest taste, aroma, and quality by brewing fresh, full-flavored loose leaf tea with ease. This set includes 2 Heart Tea Infusers, which allow you to easily brew your favorite loose leaf tea, without worrying about the contents falling out and creating a mess. The infusers are constructed of durable stainless steel for long-lasting, rust-free use and are the perfect size for a single cup of tea. The cute tea balls come equipped with a chain and hook, which together let the ball effortlessly hang from your mug or teapot for hassle-free removal when your herbs have fully steeped. Also can be used with bouquet garni or spices for winter mulled wine, broth and more. It's just your cup of tea!
